correctness.rationale: The equivalence of serial/transitive/right-Euclidean relations with nonempty-marked partition blocks is proved in both directions. An explicit coupling to independent fair vertex marks conditioned to hit every partition block, elementary sublinear mean block count, hypergeometric representative lower bound, Stirling estimate and Chernoff bound prove the local and sharp two-sided tail entropy limits for fixed interior densities. Complete serial-relation enumeration on up to four worlds and independent exact combinatorial recurrence checks through ten worlds corroborate finite steps.

value.rationale: The proportion of reflexive worlds is an invariant directly tied to finite doxastic Kripke semantics. The theorem supplies a complete binary-entropy rate for its atypical values, not just a known finite table, and identifies the underlying asymptotic mechanism: the nonempty-core constraint is only subexponentially costly. It is a natural benchmark for uniformly sampled KD45 frames and explicitly restricts its claims to the logarithmic scale.
